description: This file contains C# source code defining classes for generating and managing event data streams for Azure Event Hubs within the Orleans framework. It includes classes for generating data for individual streams and for partitions, with methods for creating data, controlling stream production, and logging activities.

classes.name: SimpleStreamEventDataGenerator
classes.description: Generates event data for a single stream, implementing the IStreamDataGenerator interface for EventData objects.

classes.name: EventHubPartitionDataGenerator
classes.description: Generates event data for an Event Hub partition, managing multiple stream data generators and controlling their activity.

methods.name: TryReadEvents
methods.description: Attempts to generate up to maxCount EventData objects for the stream or partition.

methods.name: CreateFactory
methods.description: Creates a factory function to instantiate SimpleStreamEventDataGenerator instances.

methods.name: AddDataGeneratorForStream
methods.description: Adds a new stream data generator for a specific stream ID.

methods.name: StopProducingOnStream
methods.description: Stops data production for a specific stream ID.
